summary: Hub Cyber Security Ltd. (HUBC) filed a Form 6-K disclosing its purchase of purchase rights for Evofem Biosciences common stock via a Securities Purchase Agreement dated July 20, 2026, closing July 21, 2026. The purchase rights have a $4,000,000 face amount, enabling purchase of up to 259.74 million Evofem shares at $0.0154 per share. Consideration was $15.2 million (3.8x face), paid in 10,133,333 consideration shares (590,107 ordinary shares and 9,543,226 pre-funded warrants at $1.50 per share). Pre-funded warrants have a $0.001 exercise price, no expiration, and a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation, which may terminate upon shareholder approval. HUBC also engaged PR Capital as non-exclusive financial advisor for a potential merger, issuing 2,627,118 shares/warrants (2.5% of Evofem's valuation). PR Capital's restricted shares are forfeitable if no transaction closes within seven months. Watch for shareholder approval and potential transaction announcements; risk-arb focuses on Evofem deal consummation.
